name: ClientResult
reason: The results a client returns; no message carries them - a client answers only requests, and schema.ts declares no ServerRequest, so no party sends a client-to-server response.

name: JSONRPCMessage
reason: The wire's generic vocabulary - any JSON-RPC message is one of these - which the protocol's root does not admit: a message that is none of the typed ones is refused (an unknown method, another protocol version). Held as a definition for the witness; the typed messages compose over the house headers, not over it.
